title: Mass Spectrometry of Protein Post-Translational Modifications Protocol
author: Mannan Nouri
materials: Conduct binding of antibody-target complexes from IP and IgG control samples by incubating with 50-250µL of Protein-A DynaBeads (Thermo Scientific, #10002D) each according to manufacturer’s instructions, overnight at 4°C on a rotator.

Based on LC-MS/MS equipment and software available, MS/MS spectra are typically analyzed using Mascot version 2.6 (Matrix Science) by searching the reversed and concatenated human protein database ( http://www.ebi.ac.uk/uniprot/database/download.html ) with a parent ion tolerance of 15 ppm and fragment ion tolerance of 0.05 Da. Carbamidomethylation of Cys are specified as a fixed modification and oxidation of Met, deamidation of Asp/Gln, phosphorylation of Ser/Thr/Tyr, ubiquitinylation of Lys, methylation and dimethylation of Lys/Arg and acetylation of Lys/Arg as variable modifications. Results are imported into Scaffold Q + S 5.0 software (Proteome Software, Inc.) with a peptide false discovery rate (FDR) of ~1.1%.

steps.title: Harvest Protein from Cells
steps.instruction: Harvest proteins from three 10cm dishes per condition.

substeps.instruction: Wash cells in ice-cold PBS.
Scrape cells in 1000µL of RIPA lysis buffer per dish.
Transfer to individual 5mL tubes.
Incubate at 4°C for 30 minutes.
Freeze at -80°C.

steps.title: Prepare Immunoprecipitation Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare Input and IP samples from RIPA-harvested proteins.

substeps.instruction: Spin down samples at max G and remove cell debris pellet.
Prepare Input samples by taking 100µL from each sample and storing at -20°C.

Prepare IP samples by taking 2.1mL of each sample and incubating with target protein antibody (e.g., α-FoxA1, 5µg, Cell Signaling, #53528, clone E7E8W) for 2 hours at 4°C on a rotator per manufacturer's instructions.

Prepare IgG control samples by taking 410µL of each sample and incubating with matched IgG control antibody (e.g., Rabbit IgG, 1µg, Cell signaling, #2729S) for 2 hours at 4°C on a rotator per manufacturer's instructions.

steps.title: Perform Protein Pulldown
steps.instruction: Conduct pulldown using Dynabeads and target antibodies.

substeps.instruction: Incubate lysates with α-FoxA1 antibody (or other target), IgG control, and Dynabeads overnight.
Separate magnetic bead pellets from supernatant; discard all but 100µL of supernatant for Flowthrough analysis.
Wash FoxA1 pulldown magnetic bead pellets five times with 400µL of RIPA plus protease and phosphatase inhibitors.
Re-suspend magnetic bead pellets in 100µL of RIPA and transfer to a clean tube.
Separate pellets from supernatant and replace supernatant with 65µL of RIPA + 2X Laemmli buffer for FOXA1 IPs, or 20µL of RIPA + 2X Laemmli buffer for IgG IPs.
Heat samples at 70°C for 10 minutes to elute bound proteins.
Separate magnetic bead pellets from supernatant and transfer the supernatant (containing FoxA1 proteins) to a new clean tube; add 2.5% β-mercaptoethanol.

steps.title: Analyze Samples via Western Blot
steps.instruction: Perform Western blot on Input, IgG, FOXA1 IP, and IP Flowthrough samples.

substeps.instruction: Prepare samples in Laemmli buffer and 2.5% β-mercaptoethanol.
Load samples onto a BioRad pre-cast 4-20% 15-Well gradient gel, placing an empty well between sample sets to prevent contamination.
Run gel at 10 milliamps constant for 30 minutes, then 50 milliamps constant until the dye front reaches the appropriate distance (do not allow protein of interest to exit the gel).
Fast-transfer gel to Nitrocellulose membrane (BioRad, #1704270) at 2.5 amps and 25 volts for 7 minutes using a Trans-Blot Turbo Transfer System (BioRad, #1704150).
Block membrane in 5% MILK-TBST for 60 minutes.
Wash membranes twice in TBS-T and incubate overnight at 4°C on a rocker with target (e.g., α-FOXA1) and loading control (e.g., α-Vinculin) antibodies.
Wash membranes three times in TBS-T for 15 minutes total, then incubate with appropriate secondary antibody at room temperature for one hour on a rocker.
Wash membranes three times in TBS-T for 15 minutes total and visualize to confirm target enrichment.

steps.title: Prepare Gel for Mass Spectrometry
steps.instruction: Run and process a separate gel for FOXA1 IP samples to isolate protein bands.

substeps.instruction: Prepare FOXA1 IP samples in Laemmli buffer and 2.5% β-mercaptoethanol.
Load IgG and FOXA1 IP samples onto a BioRad pre-cast 7.5% 10-Well gradient gel, placing an empty well between sample sets.
Run gel at 10 milliamps constant for 30 minutes, then 50 milliamps constant until the dye front reaches the appropriate distance.
Wash the gel three times for 5 min with clean Milli-Q H2O.
Stain with Coomassie Blue solution (BioRad, #1610436) for 45 minutes with gentle shaking.
Wash the gel three times for 5 min with clean Milli-Q H2O.
Destain overnight with gentle shaking using 40% methanol, 10% acetic acid, and 50% H2O.
Wash the gel three times for 5 min with clean Milli-Q H2O.
Image the gel and cut out visible bands around the 50kDa marker for FOXA1, and cut out one empty lane for Gel Background sample.
Fix the gel with 40% methanol, 10% acetic acid, and 50% H2O for 1 hour.

steps.title: Process Bands for Mass Spectrometry
steps.instruction: Prepare isolated protein bands for LC-MS/MS analysis.

substeps.instruction: Wash cut bands twice in 50% acetonitrile.
Store bands in a -20°C freezer until analysis.
Trypsinize, separate, and analyze peptides by microcapillary reversed-phase liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) according to manufacturer’s instructions.
